Saved Views is available today, giving every user a faster way to work with the lists and boards they rely on most. Instead of rebuilding filters, sorting, and grouping each time you open a project, you can now capture the exact setup you want and return to it instantly. Saved Views is included in all paid plans, so teams on any subscription tier can start using it right away without an upgrade.

Each user can save up to 50 views, covering everything from a personal daily task list to a sprint-specific board filtered by priority or assignee. Views can also be shared with a team, making it easy to give teammates the same perspective on a project without asking them to recreate settings on their own.

Whether you're tracking overdue tasks, watching a sprint, or following a client's open requests, Saved Views helps everyone get back to what matters most, quickly and consistently.

Open any list and select Save view to get started.
